sources.note: 3.6/5 across183 reviews; ten most-recent full entries inspected separately from platform totals and generated summaries.

limitations: Informed Choice is a banned-substance program with monthly sampling, not proof that every current lot was tested or that heavy metals are absent.
The NSF register returned seven other finished products for Naked Whey, Inc.; absence of this whey listing is an unresolved claim-verification gap, not proof of contamination.
The score covers unflavored U.S. whey concentrate. Findings about flavored products or Naked Vegan Mass must not be transferred to this formula.

consumerSources.summary: The recent sample mixes favorable product and delivery experiences with stock, subscription, support and refund complaints.
positives: Reviewers praised taste, easy mixing, packaging and punctual delivery.
concerns: Several described delays or stock gaps. Others disputed duplicate subscription shipments, return charges or membership refunds; one questioned vanilla flavor-label consistency.
consumerSources.sampling: Read the first ten complete entries under Most recent. Dates represent reported experiences; excluded preview duplicates and the platform’s AI summary.
consumerSources.limitations: Self-selected accounts across countries and multiple products, including flavored whey, pea protein and collagen. Allegations were not independently verified. The 183 total and weighted 3.6 Trustpilot score are not the ten-review sample average.

changeNote: Initial registry research: independently hosted product match, exact U.S. variant and label, buying terms, source limitations and individually inspected consumer feedback. Score calculated under the unchanged evidence-v2 rubric.
